description: This Java source file defines the PolicySetupActivity class, which is an Android Activity responsible for managing device administration policies within an Android application. It provides UI for configuring password policies, activating device admin rights, and viewing current policies. The code includes handling for UI initialization, user interactions, system intents for device admin activation and password setting, and persistent preferences management.

classes.name: PolicySetupActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity for configuring and viewing device admin policies, handling user interaction for policy setup, activation, and password enforcement.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and creates a Policy object.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes activity, loading saved state and updating UI based on device admin status.

methods.name: setScreenContent
methods.description: Sets the activity's content view based on specified layout ID, and initializes the respective screen.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Persists policy data when the activity is paused.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from device admin activation intent.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back navigation to return from view policy to setup screen.

methods.name: initPolicySetupScreen
methods.description: Initializes UI components and populates policy setup screen.

methods.name: initViewPolicyScreen
methods.description: Populates the view policy screen with current policy data.

methods.name: initNavigation
methods.description: Configures navigation button and message based on current policy status.

methods.name: mActivateButtonListener
methods.description: Handles activation of device administrator, launches system intent for activation.

methods.name: mEnforcePolicyListener
methods.description: Handles enforcement of password policy, launching password reset intent.

methods.name: setupNavigation
methods.description: Configures message and action button for navigation UI.

methods.name: writePolicy
methods.description: Saves current policy settings from UI input into persistent preferences.
